# DPA-SDT full reference

## Overview
DPA-SDT is a fresh independent publication snapshot of a self-declared token and decentralized partnership research prototype.
The repository is private and contains one initial commit without old history.
It is not a GitHub fork and does not replace or alter the old source repository.
Publishing it makes no hosting or blockchain changes.
Author: Maxim Osovsky.
Repository: https://github.com/maximosovsky/DPA-SDT

## Scope
Use fictional inputs only.
The SDT v2 commitment binds thirteen exact identity and bank-trace fields.
Serialization is domain-separated SHA-256 with ordered named UTF-8 fields and uint32 big-endian byte lengths.
No trimming, case conversion, Unicode normalization, or silent correction is performed.
The existing cryptopassport domain separator is preserved intentionally.
Self-declaration does not verify identity, banking activity, or legal rights.
Partnership formation records EOA EIP-712 acceptance and immutable snapshots.
Agreement text is maintained off-chain with portable evidence.
Exclusive package issuance uses ERC-721 rather than legacy ERC-1155 backing.
Package splitting burns parents without creating additional quantity.
Sale, pledge, and funded loan flows are synthetic testnet experiments.
Local tests use isolated simulated contracts and public development accounts.
Do not use the public Hardhat development mnemonic on any public network.
Never supply private keys, real identity documents, or real banking data to the interface.

## Architecture
All project files remain within test-deployment/.
contracts/: Solidity contract implementations.
client/: browser application entry points and styles.
src/: hashing, agreement, evidence, state, and contract-provenance helpers.
HTML pages: declaration, partnership, shares, packages, sale, verifier, and legal notices.
test/: inherited node and Hardhat regression tests.
scripts/: local and historical research runners; not automatically executed.
canonical-artifacts/: six exact deployed ABI/bytecode JSON artifacts.
docs/: specifications, threat model, test matrix, and evidence.
package.json and package-lock.json: preserved dependency declarations.

## Dependencies
Node.js >=22.13; tested publication environment used Node.js 26.7.0.
TypeScript 5.9.3.
Solidity compiler 0.8.28.
OpenZeppelin contracts 5.4.0.
Hardhat 3.19.0.
Vite 7.3.7.
viem 2.57.6.
Playwright 1.64.1.

## Local commands
cd test-deployment
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run compile
node --experimental-strip-types --test test/identity-hash-v2.test.ts
npm run build
npm run dev -- --port 4173 --strictPort
Local UI: http://127.0.0.1:4173/
Compile before building a fresh checkout; six pinned artifacts alone are insufficient.
No wallet key or RPC credential is needed for the static build.
The inherited npm test:hash script names a missing old file; use the explicit v2 command.

Some inherited tests expect removed archives or stale UI/navigation details.
See VERIFICATION.md for actual commands, failures, and warnings.

## Historical evidence
Retained: test-deployment/docs/evidence/base-sepolia/published-nine/.
Retained: test-deployment/docs/evidence/base-sepolia/exclusive-nft-package/.
Final-nine manifest: nine scenarios and 31 distinct successful receipt hashes.
Do not restate this bundle as 30 transactions.
Recorded provider: controlled Playwright EIP-1193 test-wallet adapter.
Not a manual MetaMask extension run.
Raw evidence retains failed/probe records; final manifest describes reconciliation.
No historical transaction was rerun for this publication.
No fresh RPC receipt verification or L1-finality claim is made.
Older two-party and non-exclusive NFT receipt archives are omitted.
Existing evidence dates, hashes, host URLs, and local source paths remain immutable.

## Provenance and rights
PROVENANCE.md identifies the original source commit and canonical repository.
snapshot-manifest.json records copied file sizes and SHA-256 hashes.
Source README and documents are retained as source-era material, not new hosting instructions.
No article drafts, PDFs, private operational journals, environment files, or pickle files are published.
No repository-wide LICENSE existed in the source.
No new license is introduced.
Contract SPDX UNLICENSED and site-content CC BY 4.0 attribution are preserved.
Site notices do not relicense research text, contracts, or dependencies.
No roadmap or unsupported deployment promises are invented.
